title: i72x.6.a: reference_schnorr48 upstream AddrForKey + regenerate root_dio_signature.json
description: Child of i72x.6 step 3 (root_dio_signature corpus only). (1) Add upstream yggdrasil-go AddrForKey bit-packing to test/vectors/reference_schnorr48.py as an independent reference function (NO hashing: bit-invert pubkey, count leading 1 bits into addr[1], drop first 0 bit, bit-pack remainder into addr[2:16] per yggdrasil_address.json profiles.upstream_go_addr_for_key); rewire ReferenceIdentity.from_seed ygg_addr to it (iid/kid STAYS SHA-512-derived per C test main.c:243 expected_kid). Validate the function against: pinned anchor in test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json AND live output of ~/GIT/yggdrasil-go (build + tiny Go program or existing CLI) for the vector pubkey e7a96ef0... — never impl-derived. (2) Regenerate test/vectors/root_dio_signature.json via test/vectors/generate_root_dio_signature.py (same seeds/fields; dodag_id=AddrForKey; re-sign; expected anchor for root seed 000102..*4: 020030ad221f03322adb901f8b731688 per C test main.c:39 comment — verify independently). (3) Verify Python root-dio corpus tests stay green; run pytest on affected dirs. Do NOT touch other corpora (separate beads).
close_reason: All three steps complete (commit 635683fa92). (1) reference_schnorr48.upstream_addr_for_key added — exact yggdrasil-go AddrForKey bit-packing (bit-invert, leading-ones count with wrapping u8, skip first 0, MSB-first whole-byte pack into addr[2:16], trailing partial byte discarded, zero tail, no hashing); ReferenceIdentity.from_seed rewired to it; iid/kid UNCHANGED (SHA-512) per C test main.c expected_kid. (2) root_dio_signature.json regenerated via generate_root_dio_signature.py: 14 vectors, dodag_id = upstream AddrForKey bytes (root seed 000102..x4 -> 020030ad221f03322adb901f8b731688, matching the C main.c:39 comment anchor), kid 203df4662ab81f5a preserved, all valid vectors cross_verify_passed=True; impersonation-vector semantics verified (attacker dodag == upstream(attacker_pubkey), claimed != attacker). (3) Oracle validation: pinned upstream_addr_for_key anchor in yggdrasil_address.json (byte-exact) AND live yggdrasil-go (go run src/address harness) for the root pubkey e7a96ef0... — Python reference matches Go byte-for-byte on both. Python suites: crypto 744 passed / 5 skipped / 0 failed; orphan_vector_consumers 39 passed with the migration-era non-strict xfail marker RETIRED (its reason text designated xpass as the corpus-regenerated signal). Pre-existing lora_medium collection errors on this host are funm's (unrelated). ENV NOTE: test/vectors was group-writable (775, group has second member langwei) so the generator's atomic-write owner-only check failed closed; chmod g-w applied (host-side only, security-tightening, git does not track the bit). REVIEW: 3 kimi-k3 delegate attempts hit exploration-timeouts without verdicts (the third verified impersonation-vector semantics then ran out of budget); per loop fallback, self-reviewed correctness/security/edge passes — packing off-by-ones checked against Go semantics, oracle discipline preserved (reference never derived from impls under test). Downstream unblocked: i72x.6.3 (C resync), i72x.6.4/cbmt (Rust flip), a763 (end_to_end), f6r4, rqiq can now consume the regenerated corpus.
